confirmatory_rule.missing_data: At most one retry per failed run with identical cell identity; a seed missing a pair member is dropped from that cell's paired tests and from the slope fit (predeclared; never outcome-based).
confirmatory_rule.pairing: per-seed paired contrast trained vs frozen_random within block pb-p2b-{seed}

primary.confirm_if: p < alpha AND practical effect met
primary.description: H3: held-out utility improves as measured operational bits/token increase, at fixed width and equal convergence
primary.endpoint: per-seed slope of trained-mode final eval loss (step 2000) regressed on q_bits in {4, 8, 16, 32}
primary.practical_effect: mean eval-loss reduction from q=4 to q=32 >= 0.01 nats

privacy_criterion.frontier_rule: A cell is frontier-feasible if its secondary G_R test confirms positive gain AND its privacy advantage <= threshold. The frontier is the set of feasible (bits/token, eval loss) points; reported with per-seed CIs.
privacy_criterion.per_q: probe calibrated with latents quantized to the cell's q_bits

secondary.delta_u_per_q: mean trained-minus-all_local per q with 95% CI, descriptive.
secondary.gain_per_q: Per q_bits cell, one-sided paired t-test of G_R over 8 seeds, Bonferroni alpha 0.0125 per cell (4 tests); G_R > 0 persistence at steps 1800/1900/2000 reported.
secondary.removed_reference: mean removed-minus-all_local per q with 95% CI, descriptive.

note: Confirmatory rate-sweep analysis under protocol p2b-rate-sweep-1.0 (frozen 2026-09-04, fresh seeds [7..87]); per docs/PREREGISTRATION_P2B.md. Privacy scope: token-inversion family only; membership, property, and history-accumulation attacks remain out of scope.

primary.endpoint: per-seed slope of trained-mode final eval loss (step 2000) regressed on q_bits in {4, 8, 16, 32}
primary.practical_effect_prose: mean eval-loss reduction from q=4 to q=32 >= 0.01 nats
